title: PoppyClientMetadata
description: The document at a Personal Agent's client_id URL. Spec section 4.1 (Agent identity). client_id must equal the URL it was fetched from, and jwks_uri and each redirect_uris entry other than a loopback redirect URI must be on the same domain as client_id; those depend on the fetch and are checked separately. Unknown fields are allowed. Signed-out Session verification requires client_id and jwks_uri; client_name, redirect_uris and OAuth authentication method metadata are optional. Direct Sign-In and OAuth authenticate only when their metadata and full flow are implemented.

token_endpoint_auth_method.description: Absent or none is valid for signed-out Sessions. Account OAuth requires advertised private_key_jwt.

token_endpoint_auth_methods_supported.description: CIMD method choices. Optional OAuth must select private_key_jwt; any singular method must occur here.

loopback_url.description: A loopback redirect URI for an app on the User's computer, RFC 8252 section 7.3.
